citation: Hanson, C.; Buckingham, K.; DeWitt, S.; Laestadius, L. (2015). The Restoration Diagnostic: A Method for Developing Forest Landscape Restoration Strategies by Rapidly Assessing the Status of Key Success Factors. WRI, version 1.0.
relevance_note: Table 7, native PDF pages 48–49 (printed 44–45), contains qualitative ecological establishment questions. Mixed passive/active restoration and seed supply require full source reading and family/role separation before extraction; no numeric suitability function established.
tier_rationale: Transparent institutional diagnostic derived from cases; authors explicitly do not establish causal necessity/sufficiency.
source_lineage: Companion case studies/translations/workbook are not independent votes; overlaps ROAM planning lineage.
